job.title: Commercial Plumber / Water Hygiene Technician (Legionella Compliance)
job.description:
Commercial Plumber / Water Hygiene Technician (Legionella Compliance) – Mobile Role – Glasgow – up to £35,000 DOE

An established facilities services company is seeking a Tierr 3 Water Hygiene Technician/Commercial plumber to join their team in a permanent, full-time mobile position. The role involves working across multiple locations throughout Glasgow and the wider Central Belt.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Working closely with the technical team, schedulers, and contract administrators to efficiently deliver planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and remedial water hygiene/treatment works.
  • Carrying out temperature monitoring, showerhead descaling, cold water storage tank inspections and cleans.
  • Completing cooling tower cleaning and disinfection works.
  • Servicing Thermostatic Mixing Valves (TMVs).
  • Conducting water sampling and analysis.
  • Performing LTHW system testing and analysis.
  • Dosing systems with inhibitor and biocide chemicals.
  • Undertaking cooling system testing and analysis.
  • Completing steam boiler testing and analysis.
  • Servicing water softeners and associated equipment.
  • Carrying out plumbing remedial works as required.
  • Ensuring all ACOP L8/site logbooks are accurate, compliant, and up to date when acting as Primary Technician.
Person Specification:

  • Qualified Plumber (Essential)
  • Legionella Awareness Training including knowledge of Regulations/Byelaws, L8 ACOP, HSG274 and any other relevant guidance
  • Knowledge of Water Hygiene service delivery requirements based on Table 2.1 HSG274 Part 2
  • Valid driving licence
  • This role includes a DBS Enhanced with Barred Lists therefore ability to pass is essential.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary up to £35,000 depending on experience
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
  • Option to purchase additional annual leave
  • Paid days for volunteering or community initiatives
  • Ongoing training and development, including professional qualifications and tailored learning support

job.title: Compliance Supervisor

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Compliance Supervisor to join an established Facilities Management service provider. The successful candidate will be based out of the client's office in Essex and will be responsible for overseeing and maintaining compliance across a commercial building or portfolio of properties, ensuring that all maintenance activities, contractor works and statutory obligations are carried out in accordance with current legislation, health and safety regulations, company policies and client requirements. The role will focus heavily on the management and review of Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS), Permit to Work systems, compliance audits, statutory documentation and contractor management, ensuring that all activities are undertaken safely, efficiently and to the highest standards. The Compliance Supervisor will work closely with the Engineering Management Team, site engineers, contractors and client representatives to ensure compliance standards are consistently maintained.

Hours of work

Monday to Friday - 08:00am to 17:00pm

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Review, assess and approve contractor RAMS prior to works commencing
  • Ensure all RAMS are site-specific, accurate and appropriate for the activities being undertaken
  • Identify potential risks and ensure suitable control measures are implemented
  • Challenge and reject inadequate RAMS, ensuring appropriate amendments are made before authorisation
  • Monitor contractor activities to ensure works are undertaken in accordance with approved RAMS
  • Assist with the preparation and review of internal risk assessments and safe systems of work
  • Oversee the implementation and management of the site's Permit to Work (PTW) system
  • Ensure permits are correctly completed, authorised, monitored and closed out
  • Ensure contractors understand and comply with permit conditions and site safety requirements
  • Conduct regular inspections to verify compliance with the Permit to Work procedures
  • Support the management of statutory and mandatory maintenance compliance across the building or portfolio
  • Ensure planned preventative maintenance (PPM) records, statutory inspections and certification are accurately maintained
  • Monitor compliance relating to electrical systems, fire safety, water hygiene, HVAC systems, lifting equipment and other building services
  • Track outstanding statutory inspections, remedial actions and certification renewals
  • Liaise with engineering teams and specialist contractors to resolve outstanding compliance issues
  • Escalate overdue statutory tasks and significant compliance risks to the Engineering Management Team
  • Support compliance with relevant legislation, including the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act, Electricity at Work Regulations, COSHH and applicable building safety requirements
  • Ensure all contractors complete the required site inductions before commencing work
  • Monitor contractor performance against site health and safety standards
  • Ensure contractors follow agreed procedures, RAMS and permit requirements
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date compliance records, registers and certification
  • Produce weekly and monthly compliance reports for the Engineering Management Team and client.
Requirements

 

  • Electrically or Mechanically qualified (C&G, NVQ or apprenticeship) - Highly Desirable
  • Previous experience in a Compliance Supervisor, Compliance Coordinator, Health & Safety Supervisor or similar role within Facilities Management
  • Experience working within a commercial building, critical environment or multi-site FM contract
  • Strong knowledge of RAMS review and Permit to Work procedures
  • Experience conducting compliance audits and contractor inspections
  • Good understanding of statutory compliance requirements within building services maintenance.
  • Experience managing contractors and monitoring health and safety performance
  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to identify compliance risks and implement corrective actions
  • NEBOSH General Certificate or equivalent health and safety qualification (Desirable)
  • IOSH Managing Safely  (Desirable)
  • Experience within a managing agent, property management or hard services FM environment.
  • Happy to attend sites in and around London

job.title: Electrician
job.description:

Due to continued growth in the renewable energy sector, we are recruiting experienced professionals to support the delivery of residential and commercial Solar PV and Battery Storage installations across Scotland and the wider UK.

Successful candidates will join dedicated installation teams, working together to deliver high-quality renewable energy systems safely, efficiently, and to industry standards.

Each installation team typically consists of:

  • Renewable Energy Electricians (2 positions per team) – Responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, and certification of Solar PV and Battery Storage systems, including AC/DC wiring, inverters, and associated electrical equipment in accordance with current industry regulations.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, commission and test Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) electrical systems.
  • Complete AC/DC wiring, inverters, consumer unit upgrades and associated electrical works.
  • Carry out inspection, testing, fault finding and certification in accordance with BS 7671 and relevant industry standards.
  • Accurately complete digital job records, certification and quality assurance documentation, including photographic evidence where required.
  • Liaise professionally with customers, site teams and project managers to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Maintain high standards of health, safety and workmanship, supporting labourers and apprentices where required.
Person Specification:

Essential:

  • NVQ Level 3 in Electrical Installation (or equivalent)
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • Inspection & Testing qualification (2391 or equivalent)
  • ECS/JIB Gold Card
  • Full UK Driving Licence
  • Minimum three years' electrical installation experience
  • Strong knowledge of BS 7671 and safe isolation procedures
  • Comfortable using tablets or digital job management systems
Desirable:

  • Experience installing Solar PV and Battery Storage - (training/certification on EV charging will be provided).
  • Experience working on social housing or large-scale renewable energy programmes.
  • Knowledge of G98/G99 grid connection requirements.
  • Manufacturer training on leading renewable energy products is advantageous but not essential.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £50,000 DOE plus bonus & OT (opportunity to reach up to £70,000)
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Uniform, PPE and specialist tools provided.
  • Accommodation and meal allowances when working away where required.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

CBW Staffing Solutions is recruiting for a Mechanical Maintenance Engineer to join a client-direct, in-house maintenance team at a prestigious commercial office building in Aldgate, City of London.

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established in-house team, offering a competitive salary, an attractive benefits package and ongoing training and career progression.   • Monitor outstanding matters and ensure appropriate follow-up takes place.
  • Escalate significant, recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate level of management.
  • Report hazards, incidents, environmental concerns or other matters requiring management attention.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

  • A professional, approachable and empathetic manner.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to understand and respond appropriately to resident concerns.
  • Effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with challenging situations.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries, priorities and deadlines.
  • Good attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
  • Previous experience in a resident-facing, customer service, community engagement or similar role.
  • Experience within construction, housing, property, facilities management, refurbishment or a related environment would be advantageous.
  • Understanding of the challenges and sensitivities associated with working in occupied residential properties.
  • Experience of handling customer complaints, enquiries or service issues.
  • Familiarity with maintaining electronic records and using digital systems.

  • Salary up to £35,000 DOE
  • Van and fuel card.

  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Static Air Conditioning Engineer
job.description:
FM Service Provider – Commercial Estate – Denmark Hill, South East London - Up to £50,000 per annum

CBW Staffing Solutions are currently recruiting for a Static Air Conditioning Maintenance Engineer to work on a large, well-established commercial estate in Denmark Hill, South East London.

You’ll be part of a dedicated on-site engineering team of 8 engineers, working collaboratively to deliver a high standard of planned and reactive maintenance across the site. The team is experienced, supportive, and well-structured, ensuring you receive a thorough handover and ongoing support with the plant, systems, and site procedures. The campus benefits from excellent staff facilities, including multiple coffee outlets, on-site restaurants, dedicated break areas, and secure bike storage, creating a comfortable and well-equipped working environment. In return, the company offers a competitive salary of up to £50,000, regular overtime opportunities, 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, ongoing technical training, and clear long-term career progression within a leading FM service provider.

 

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Carry out planned and reactive maintenance on a wide range of air conditioning systems, including VRV/VRF, split systems, AHUs, and FCUs
  • Diagnose faults and carry out repairs to ensure systems operate efficiently and reliably
  • Perform routine inspections, filter changes, coil cleaning, and system testing
  • Ensure all works comply with F-Gas regulations and industry standards
  • Respond promptly and professionally to breakdowns to minimise downtime
  • Accurately complete maintenance records, job sheets, and reports
  • Work closely with the wider engineering team to ensure smooth site operations
  • Identify system improvements and recommend upgrades where appropriate
Package:

  • Salary: Up to £50,000 per annum
  • Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am–5pm (40 hours)
  • Holiday: 25 days plus bank holidays
  • Overtime: Available
  • Progression: Ongoing training and clear career development
Requirements:

  • Valid and up-to-date F-Gas certification and relevant NVQ qualifications

  • Proven experience within an HVAC / Building Services environment

  • Stable employment history within HVAC, FM, or Building Services

  • Strong technical knowledge of a broad range of air conditioning systems

  • Ability to work independently while also being an effective team player

  • Good organisational skills with the ability to manage workload and paperwork

  • Professional, client-focused approach with strong communication skills

  • Positive, proactive attitude with flexibility in approach to problem-solving

 

If this role is of interest, please don't hesitate to send your CV to Charlie at CBW Staffing Solutions.

job.title: Data Centre Operations Manager
job.description:
Data Centre Operations Manager - Client Direct - Central London - up to 100k + bonus and excellent benefits

Are you from a data centre or critical engineering background?

Would you like to work client side for a leading Data Centre company?

If so, please read on....

One of the market leaders in the data centre world is currently looking to recruit a Data Centre Operations Manager to work at a high profile data centre based in Central London. 

The role will be working closely with the Head of Operations on site and will be responsible for overseeing and coordinating all engineering activities within the data centre, to ensure optimal performance, efficiency, and reliability of critical infrastructure systems.

There will also be an oversight on the cleaning and security but this is managed indirectly via contractors. 

The main duties of the role are as follows:
  • Lead and supervise a team of engineers and technicians, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure they perform their duties effectively.
  • Plan, schedule, and prioritize maintenance, repairs, and upgrades of electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems to minimize downtime and maintain uptime SLAs.
  • Implement and enforce safety protocols and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory standards and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including facilities management, IT operations, and security to address issues and optimize data centre operations.
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracts for equipment procurement, maintenance services, and technical support.
  • Maintain technical documentation within the data centre including SOPs/EOPs/MOPs, Electrical safety rules and risk assessments.
  • Participate in capacity planning and expansion projects to support the growth of the data centre infrastructure.
  • Act as a company HVAP.
  • Be available as the 1st point of escalation for any incidents or issues.
Applicants for the role must be able to meet the following criteria:
  • Qualifications in Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in data centre operations or a similar critical infrastructure environment.
  • Proven track record of leading and managing technical teams.
  • Strong understanding of data centre infrastructure, including power, cooling, security, and network systems.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and demanding environment.
  • Leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills.
  • Project management and organizational skills.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking.

job.title: Office Manger
job.description:
Office Manager/Estates Coordinator  - Fixed Term Contract - North Lanarkshire - Salary up to £35,000 DOE

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced and highly organised Office Manager / Estates Coordinator to join a busy and professional organisation based in North Lanarkshire on a 12-month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave.

This varied role will suit a proactive, personable and hands-on individual who enjoys taking ownership of office operations while providing essential coordination and administrative support to the estates team. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the office, maintaining high standards of organisation, supporting compliance requirements and helping colleagues across the business work efficiently.

Working closely with colleagues at all levels, including senior stakeholders such as the CFO and CEOs, the Office Manager / Estates Coordinator will be responsible for managing a varied workload, coordinating multiple priorities and ensuring that office and facilities requirements are dealt with promptly and effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the day-to-day running of the office, ensuring a professional, organised and efficient working environment.
  • Provide coordination and administrative support to the estates team, comprising approximately five team members.
  • Support the maintenance of ISO compliance requirements, ensuring relevant documentation and records are accurate and up to date.
  • Assist with fire safety procedures, fire risk assessments and emergency planning to support a safe working environment.
  • Coordinate general office and facilities requirements, including office supplies, amenities, equipment replacements and maintenance requests.
  • Liaise with internal departments and external suppliers to ensure facilities and operational issues are resolved efficiently.
  • Act as a key point of contact for office-related queries, providing practical support and assistance to colleagues across the business.
  • Communicate confidently and professionally with senior stakeholders, including the CFO and CEOs.
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation and administrative systems to support effective office and estates management.
  • Assist with coordinating priorities, organising tasks and ensuring actions are followed up within agreed timescales.
  • Identify opportunities to improve office procedures, administrative processes and overall operational efficiency.
  • Provide general organisational and administrative support as required, adapting to the changing needs of the business.
Person Specification:

  • The successful candidate will be an experienced Office Manager, Office Coordinator or Facilities Administrator who is confident managing a varied workload and taking responsibility for ensuring that day-to-day operations run smoothly.
  • You will be highly organised, proactive and approachable, with excellent communication skills and the ability to build effective working relationships with colleagues at all levels of the organisation. 
  • You should be comfortable working independently, using your initiative to resolve issues and prioritising competing demands in a busy working environment.
  • Previous experience in office management, office coordination or a similar administrative role.
  • Experience coordinating facilities, maintenance, suppliers or general office requirements.
  • Knowledge of health and safety procedures, fire safety or ISO compliance would be advantageous.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence liaising with senior stakeholders.
  • Strong administrative skills, including document control, record keeping and maintaining accurate information.
What the Role Offers:

  • A competitive salary of £30,000–£35,000, depending on experience.
  • A Monday-to-Friday working pattern, 9:00am–5:00pm.
  • A 12-month fixed-term opportunity within a varied and engaging role.
  • The opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and support a dedicated estates team.
  • A position where strong organisational skills, initiative and a hands-on approach will make a genuine difference.

job.title: Mobilisation Engineer
job.description:
Mobilisation Engineer - FM Service Provider - Upminster - £47,000

Are you an experienced M&E engineer looking for your next challenge?

A leading FM service provider is seeking a Mobilisation Engineer to join their growing team, supporting the setup and transition of new contracts across London.

Based from the Upminster office with regular travel to sites across London, you'll work Monday to Friday, 08:00–17:00. As a core member of the mobilisation team, you'll play a hands-on role in bringing new contracts to life, from initial surveys through to full handover. During quieter mobilisation periods, you'll apply the same expertise to existing contracts, helping to drive consistency and quality across the portfolio.

Key responsibilities

  • Verify assets and provide clear remedial recommendations where required
  • Capture comprehensive photographic evidence of all plant items, including those requiring repair or replacement
